routes.role: Configured local process subject, operator, local_demo; same-origin loopback Studio proxy. No distinct officer session role is demanded. PrivateSpatialGuard rejects cross-site fetches.

GET /targets.request: UUID caseId; optional readiness enum and UUID cursor only, each once
GET /targets.response: caseId; items (max 200); counts of all eight readiness states, case-wide and independent of filter/page; nextCursor; packages (max 100, independent of page/filter); packagesTruncated
GET /targets.packageFields: packageId, areaId, anchorItemId, revision, state, nullable reviewFingerprint, nullable findingCounts by code, eight counts
GET /targets.targetFields: targetId, caseId, anchorItemId, packageId, featureId, locator, kind=building, stage=1..8, readiness, blockedBy codes, nullable reason, nullable confirmationId, nullable priorityAt, artefacts, updatedAt
GET /targets.artefactFields: optional record{id,revision}, snapshot{id,digest}, identity string, plan{id,version,sha256}, planConfirmation{id}, packet{id}, card{id,revision}, verification=consistent

POST /confirmations.request: requestKey UUID; officer acknowledgement 1..500 characters, nonblank, verbatim; 1..100 unique package pins {packageId,revision,reviewFingerprint}; 0..100 unique ready target UUIDs belonging to those packages

GET /confirmations/{confirmationId}.response: confirmationId, caseId, requestKey, subject, acknowledgement, exact packages, targets, reason, expiresAt, createdAt, progress (listed targets), counts{recorded,carded,stopped}, nullable findingCounts. Recorded counts every target with record in named packages; carded/stopped count this confirmation only.

POST /confirmations/{confirmationId}/ret.response: 202 confirmation; same subject only, before expiresAt

POST /targets/{targetId}/priority.response: 200 target; requires confirmationId and readiness confirmed or recorded

refusals.422 INTAKE_TARGET_QUERY: Use one optional readiness and cursor, and no other query fields.
409 INTAKE_CONFIRMATION_STALE: Package {id} has no targets in this case.
Package {id} has no review of its current revision.
Target {id} is not in this case.
Target {id} belongs to a package this confirmation does not name.
refusals.409 INTAKE_CONFIRMATION_KEY: This request key was used with a different confirmation.
refusals.403 INTAKE_RUN_OPERATOR: Only the officer who confirmed can retry this run.
refusals.409 INTAKE_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED: This confirmation has expired; confirm again.
refusals.409 INTAKE_TARGET_NOT_WAITING: This target is {readiness}; only a waiting one is moved up.
refusals.403 INGESTION_ACCESS_CHANGED: The configured local access context changed.
refusals.403 CROSS_ORIGIN_READ: Cross-origin spatial reads are not allowed.
refusals.503 LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIGURATION: Set ULPIN_LOCAL_OPERATOR_SUBJECT to a valid local process attribution subject (1–256 characters, no surrounding whitespace or ASCII control characters). The historical default cannot be used for new attribution.
refusals.schemaValidation: UUID, strict fields, ranges and enums refused by Zod/API validation; acknowledgement: Use a non-blank acknowledgement in the officer's words.; duplicate packages: Name each package once.; duplicate targets: Name each target once.; JSON body capped at 32 KiB. Screen displays API message unchanged.

preparing.words: The package is being prepared for review.
preparing.rule: No review of current revision; prepare job reviews and redecides open targets.

ready.words: Ready to record and make a card.
ready.rule: Current review, feature still present, source-native candidate, not source workspace; findings/unknowns do not block. Confirmation moves listed targets to confirmed.

needs_answer.words: An answer is needed before this building can continue.
needs_answer.rule: Enum/open state; current target writer does not assign it. Intake item needs_answer is separate. Re-preparation redecides open targets.

held.words: This building cannot continue with the current evidence.
held.rule: Source workspace, missing feature, non-source-native geometry, or refused review; re-preparation redecides open targets.

confirmed.words: The officer has confirmed this building for a card.
confirmed.rule: Stored confirmation; package commit moves it to recorded or refusal stops it.

recorded.words: This building is in the register.
recorded.rule: Package commit, record artefact, stage at least 3. Only listed targets continue to card; others remain recorded.

carded.words: Its property card is made and verified.
carded.rule: Exact card revision is consistent, current and unrevoked; terminal.

stopped.words: Work stopped; the completed steps are kept.
stopped.rule: Product refusal stores code/message; retry clears blockers and restores recorded or confirmed before expiry.

stages.5: Keep a snapshot of the record
stages.7: Make the evidence plan and packet
stages.8: Make and verify the property card
stages.qualification: Stages are stored checkpoints, not percentage or next-step promises. Targets start at 2, commit stores 3, snapshot 5, identity-not-applicable 6, plan/confirm/execute 7, card/verification 8; no current stage 1 or 4 writer.

storedWords: reason written by create/prepare/holdPackageTargetsTx, confirmation storeTx, recordPackageTargetsTx, advanceIntakeTargetTx, stopIntakeTargetTx and resumeTx; blockedBy is empty except refused review or stopped step code. Show reason verbatim, never translate it.
validity: 24 hours from confirmation creation; intakeConfirmationReason: Confirmed by the officer in intake confirmation {id} on {YYYY-MM-DD}. Retry cannot extend expiry.

events.change: intake.target {targetId,readiness,stage}, in CaseIngestionEvent with sequence/case/cursor; no reasons or artefacts, refetch
events.existing: table/events.ts exports initialStream/reduceFrame, but intake.target has no sourceId and is ignored. useTableStream exports only table-specific hook; openTableStream not exported, and no generic kind callback. A small run-local connection listens to ready/ingestion.change/resync without changing table.

links.reuse: ListedCards and cards.ts consume a different unit/snapshot listing; reuse registryCard path helpers and link anatomy, not fabricate ListedCard inputs.

findings: No shared code-to-words map found in features/review or elsewhere in Studio. Area findings display each record's message. findingCounts supplies only codes/counts, no messages. Use short words for known area rule codes from services/geo/geo/area.py; unknown codes described as finding words unavailable, code beside count, never invent severity.
rediscovery: There is no case confirmation list. Read distinct non-null confirmationId from every targets page read, independently of visible readiness filter. For reload, walk unfiltered cursors solely to discover ids; display list remains cursor-paged, never labelled all.
typedClient: schema.d.ts contains GET targets, POST confirmation, GET confirmation, POST retry, POST priority (five paths).
gaps: findingCounts has no stored finding messages; no existing Studio code vocabulary export.
